title: Milestones (v1)
description: Dated events that can change energy use, such as a boiler installation. Unknown extra fields are allowed.

date_precision.description: How much of date is known. For year only the year is meant (date is then 1 January of that year); for month only the year and month (date is then the first day of that month); for day the whole date. Optional: when absent, treat as day.

kind.description: For example boiler, solar_connected or other. New values may be added.

label_es.description: Empty when the site is built in English only.
